message:
Six more Christmas markets this weekend, from Nelson to Greenwood. Swipe for the day, the hours and the hall.

Friday starts with the Indigenous Holiday Market at The Pit in Castlegar, 10 am to 2 pm, then the Trafalgar Middle School Winter Market in Nelson, 4:30 to 8:30 pm. Cranbrook's Winter Market runs Saturday and Sunday at Western Financial Place, and it's free. Saturday also brings the Pals Craft Fair in Nakusp, the Procter Hall Christmas Craft Fair and the Kettle River Art Club market in Greenwood.

Glade has a market on Saturday and Castlegar has a craft fair on Sunday. They are all on kootenayslate.ca/christmas, with more. Save this for the weekend.

#kootenayslate #kootenays #christmasmarket #craftfair #shoplocal

Santa parades are coming to town, and the first one is a week away.

Fernie starts the season with its Holiday Kick-Off Weekend on Friday, Dec 4. On Saturday, Dec 5, Cranbrook's Santa Claus Parade rolls through downtown at 5:30 pm, and Canal Flats holds its Christmas Parade at 6 pm. Trail has its Downtown Santa Parade on Friday, Dec 11 at 5:30 pm.

Bring a warm hat, a thermos and the kids. Check the time on the event page before you head out, since plans can change with the weather.

More parades and light-ups across the Kootenays are at kootenayslate.ca/christmas

#kootenayslate #kootenays #christmasparade #santaclausparade #christmasinbc

The Nutcracker comes to the Key City Theatre in Cranbrook next weekend.

There are two shows. Saturday, December 5 is at 6:30 pm, and Sunday, December 6 is a 3 pm matinee. Tickets are $15 to $30, and that includes the fee.

The Sunday show is an easy outing with the kids. If you've never seen it live, this could be the year it turns into a family tradition.

Who are you taking? Tag them.

#kootenayslate #kootenays #cranbrook #thenutcracker #kootrocks

Christmas on stage this weekend, from Fernie to Nelson. Swipe for five shows.

Holiday Roads plays Castlegar New Life Church on Friday and Saturday at 7 pm, $10 to $20. On Saturday, The Peppermint Parlour holiday cabaret is at The Royal in Nelson at 8:30 pm, and Jason Scott's Diamond Forever Christmas celebration is at Knox on 2nd in Fernie at 7 pm. Sunday brings a Christmas Charity Concert at Mt Zion Lutheran Church in Cranbrook at 2 pm, $12, and The Muppet Christmas Carol at Fort Steele at 3 pm, $8.50.

All five are on kootenayslate.ca/christmas, with more. Which one is yours?

#kootenayslate #kootenays #christmasconcert #livemusic #nelsonbc

Saturday, December 5 is International Volunteer Day, and 2026 is the UN's year of volunteers.

Groups close to home could use a hand this winter. Our sister site, Kootenay Helpers, lists volunteer roles from local groups across the region, town by town, so you can find one near you in a few minutes.

Pick your town, find a role that fits your week, and get in touch. A few hours can mean a lot to a small group.

Find yours at kootenayhelpers.ca

#kootenayslate #kootenays #volunteer #internationalvolunteerday #volunteerbc
